item.description: title: “Project 1 Documentation” date: 2025-12-03T22:55:00-05:00 draft: false Project 1 API Documentation Books Purpose: Keep a collection of books storing relevant information such as name, author, and year. Endpoints: GET /books: Returns all books GET /books/{id}: Returns a specific book based on the id POST /books: Creates a new book in the database PUT/PATCH /books/{id}: Modifies an already existing book based on the id DELETE /books/{id}: Removes a book from the database based on the id

title: “Project List” date: 2025-12-03T23:01:00-05:00 draft: false Selected Projects This document outlines several completed and ongoing technical and creative projects. Modified “Turing Test” with an English Focus The goal of this project is to both inform about and assess Generative AI’s ability to participate in creative writing and compare its output to that created by humans. The assessment is conducted via a modified “Turing Test” to see if readers are able to differentiate between human and AI writers.
